name: Moonlight Energy 2
original_name: ムーンライトエナジー２
source:
"Moonlight Energy 2" is a sequel to "Moonlight Enegy". The game's premise is nearly identical to that of the predecessor: the player controls a high school student named Maki, participating in her lesbian escapades with other students or personnel.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/moonlight-energy-2]Moby Games[/url]]
